metadata.title: Warm Glow Portrait with Wide Sans-Serif Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A high-key over-the-shoulder portrait featuring a warm, golden lens flare that interacts with wide-tracked, geometric sans-serif display text.
excludeWhen: dark or moody lighting is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up portrait of a woman looking back over her shoulder, characterized by a dominant warm light source creating a soft-focus glow and lens flare that partially obscures the subject's hair and integrates with the typography.
coreVisualRelationships: The lens flare acts as a bridge between the subject and the text.
The wide tracking of the text balances the large scale of the portrait.
Warm highlights in the hair harmonize with the golden hue of the lettering.
coreInvariants: High-key lighting with a warm, golden color temperature.
Over-the-shoulder composition with the subject looking toward the viewer.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject occupies the right two-thirds of the frame in a close-up scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bright lens flare in the center-left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the subject's eyes, down the curve of the hair to the text on the left, then back through the lens flare.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal, primarily located in the upper left corner and around the text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm white and cream (background and highlights)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep brown and bronze (hair shadows and text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value with low to moderate saturation, creating a soft, ethereal feel.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain a warm, monochromatic-adjacent range of golds and browns

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single family with varying weights or sizes for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, sturdy geometric feel.
Provides the modern geometric clarity and width.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key portrait of a woman with long wavy hair looking over her shoulder. Apply a strong golden lens flare from the left side that softens the hair texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of all-caps, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif text on the left side. The text should have a bronze color and appear slightly behind the brightest part of the lens flare.

verificationChecks: Is the text tracking sufficiently wide?
Does the lens flare interact with the text and hair?
Is the color palette consistently warm?

mustAchieve: Clean, legible but widely spaced typography

postGenerationChecks: Check that the lens flare does not make the text illegible.
Ensure the subject's gaze is directed toward the viewer.
Verify the monolinear stroke weight of the font.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key portrait + Golden Lens Flare + Wide Geometric Sans-Serif = Ethereal Pop Aesthetic
